segments.line: Monday. Your mum can't open the pickle jar.
Tuesday. You close your bedroom door, and
the handle comes off in your hand.
Thursday. Mo kicks the football onto the garage roof. You
throw your schoolbag up to knock it down.
The bag goes straight through the roof.
Saturday. The ball rolls under Dad's car.
So you lift the car. With one hand.
Day ten. Mo goes for a high five, and you stop.
Your hand freezes an inch from his.
Because you know exactly what would happen if you touched him.

It never stops. It never goes back.
So what would actually happen to you if your strength doubled every single day?
